candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the order service's call to payment (/v1/authorizations) hits a transport ReadTimeout; payment is the slow downstream, propagating 502 through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side latency metrics; inventory/redis calls succeed, so payment is the bounded suspect.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout shows repeated 502s at ~2s. Traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout while inventory/redis succeed, and topology confirms order depends on payment. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency causing checkout 502s.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment-side slowness rather than network path
Payment-side traces or logs for /v1/authorizations timeouts
